# BetterBags - Teleports

## [4.0.0](https://github.com/AlexHaible/BetterBags-Teleports/tree/4.0.0) (2026-09-21)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/AlexHaible/BetterBags-Teleports/compare/3.1.5...4.0.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/AlexHaible/BetterBags-Teleports/releases)

- Add WoW: Forever support and split data per game version  
    - Add per-flavor TOCs (Mainline, Mists, TBC, Vanilla, Camelot) and drop  
      packager TOC generation  
    - Split data.lua into one file per expansion under data/; each TOC loads  
      only the files its client needs  
    - Add standalone data/forever.lua for WoW: Forever (Camelot), which also  
      flags the client since it reports WOW\_PROJECT\_MAINLINE  
    - Replace per-expansion gating in main.lua with a table-driven loader,  
      add per-item minInterface, guard the TUTORIAL\_TITLE31 wipe, localize  
      option labels  
    - Add Stormwind Medallion, Scepter of Celebras and Lunar Festival  
      Invitation to the classic list  
    - Update bug report template game versions
